:::
::::

`--obsm_integrated`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which .obsm slot to store the resulting integrated embedding.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"X_pca_integrated"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_covariates`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The .obs field(s) that define the covariate(s) to regress out.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"batch"`, `"sample"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--theta`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Diversity clustering penalty parameter. Can be set as a single value for all batch observations or as multiple values, one for each observation in the batches defined by --obs_covariates. theta=0 does not encourage any diversity. Larger values of theta
result in more diverse clusters."
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `2.0`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::::

`--obs_cluster`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Prefix for the .obs keys under which to add the cluster labels. Newly created columns in .obs will
be created from the specified value for '--obs_cluster' suffixed with an underscore and one of the resolutions
resolutions specified in '--leiden_resolution'.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}

[Default]{.arg-key} `"harmony_integration_leiden"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--leiden_resolution`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Control the coarseness of the clustering. Higher values lead to more clusters.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/integration/harmony_leiden/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/workflows/integration/harmony_leiden);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/integration/harmony_leiden/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
